items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Well, I didn't know, see, when I was home in 45, Glennie then was around 86 or 90, something then.

ctx.x: I once asked Mr. Glennie who was the first player he ever heard pick the bass, or if he was, or who was, and he said he, first one he heard was a fellow by the name of Prudence. How do you pronounce it fast? John Prudence.
Well, I didn't know, see, when I was home in 45, Glennie then was around 86 or 90, something then.
